problem: If $\overset{―}{A}={16,18,26}$ and $\overset{―}{B}={10,16,25},$ then what is $\overset{―}{A\cap B}?$
worked_solution:
De Morgan's law for intersections states that

$$
\overset{―}{A\cap B}≡\overset{―}{A}\cup \overset{―}{B}.
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{A\cap B} & =\overset{―}{A}\cup \overset{―}{B} \\  & ={16,18,26}\cup {10,16,25} \\  & ={10,16,18,25,26}.\end{aligned}
$$
